mechanisms.title: Credit Management
mechanisms.memory_hook: The order can be commercially correct and still not be releasable.
mechanisms.question: Is this exposure acceptable for this business partner and credit segment?
mechanisms.determination: The check rule executes one or more credit-check steps against the relevant partner/segment exposure and configured limits.
controls: delivery/billing progression depending on process configuration

failure_modes.prove: Check BP risk class/check rule → credit segment → limit/exposure → failed check step.
Verify the expected check rule and its assigned steps rather than only the credit limit.

tests.setup: Use a partner/segment with controlled limit and create one order below and one above the intended threshold.
tests.assert: Credit status follows the configured check rule and exposure.

mechanisms.title: Billing
mechanisms.memory_hook: Billing starts earlier than VF04: item category already decided what can become billable.
mechanisms.question: What is the billing basis, when is it due, what billing type is created, and why does it split?
mechanisms.determination: Billing relevance defines order- vs delivery-related basis; eligible references enter the billing due list. Billing type and copy control create the billing document, while differing split-relevant header/partner fields can force separate documents.

failure_modes.symptom: Nothing appears in billing due list
failure_modes.prove: Check billing relevance → reference completion/status → billing block/date → copy-control eligibility.
Run split analysis and compare header/partner fields before changing copy routines.
Inspect copy-control pricing type before changing pricing master data.

tests.setup: Create one delivery-related and one order-related billable scenario.
tests.assert: Each enters billing from its configured reference basis.

tests.setup: Bill two references with one intentionally different split-relevant header field.
tests.assert: System produces separate billing documents and split analysis explains the difference.
